about: Routes for a GPU run of our method without instructions on the 15 SuperNI tasks of order 1. Written before the run. Same format and rules as noinstruction_routes.json (ridge = rule L with ridge 1; joint = rule J with C = 1; handicap = rule H' with t = 2; own = perfect recognition, comparison only). These are the 15 tasks on which the rule and its settings were chosen (development data); the features use at most 400 training inputs per task (half held out), test inputs are never used for fitting.
